videos.title: Apple Pay: The fast, easy, and secure way to pay.
videos.description:
Apple Pay is a fast, easy, and secure way to pay with iPhone. No digging for cards. Just double-click the side button, glance at your iPhone to authenticate with Face ID, then hold it near the reader. A ding confirms your payment. The built-in security of iPhone makes paying with Apple Pay more secure than using a physical credit or debit card. Use it anywhere you see a contactless payment symbol — from big box retailers to your local corner market.

videos.title: Apple Watch Heart Rate: Morgan’s True Apple Watch Story
videos.description:
After receiving multiple high heart rate alerts on her Apple Watch, Morgan sought medical care. Doctors identified a kidney infection that had escalated into septic shock, a potentially life threatening condition she was treated for immediately. She credits the notifications with helping save her life.

Learn more about Apple Watch heart rate notifications at https://apple.co/3W2Gfh7
